method.topology: Separate laptop network namespaces; virtual bridge, no external route; loopback HTTP secure origin on 5191
method.delay: Real wall-clock wait after B publishes reply; actual coordinator timestamps retained
method.finalOrder: A Connect then B Start connection, 1000 ms later (plus automation overhead)
method.rawA: Fake camera on A; Firefox additionally disables host address obfuscation because fake camera alone still returns mDNS. B has no camera.
method.observation: Wait up to 25 seconds after final clicks for BOTH data channels; every connected trial sends and acknowledges 20 MiB
method.concurrency: Up to 12 isolated contexts per pairing; final acceptance eight namespace pairs in parallel. Single sample per cell, not a latency benchmark.
method.clocks: New page events use per-attempt monotonic elapsedMs and wall timestamps. Old page events use performance.now from page navigation. Coordinator wall timestamps measure imposed delay; no cross-machine clock subtraction in delivered page.
limits: No real laptops, Wi-Fi, firewall, multi-interface/VPN, public HTTPS permission prompt, Safari, Windows, sleep or background tabs
